title: See every unexplained part of a change
statement: As a reviewer, I can see whether every changed line is connected to an explanation, so that I can spot unexamined parts of the change.

acceptance_criteria.statement: The coverage view marks each changed line as explained or unexplained.
Coverage updates when the selected comparison changes without requiring an author-maintained coverage record.
Unexplained legacy code does not block review when every line in the current change is explained.
